dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal maximum width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of faint, localized darker grey patches along the dorsal ridge and posterior sections.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey baseline and localized darker pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark punctate mark on the right mid-dorsal region and several circular, ring-like marks on the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed circular lesions or parasitic scars distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible textural serration or slight irregularities along the length of the dorsal ridge.
